headerDisplay: Mammotion mower control using the official API.

email.title: Account identity
email.description: When migrating, retain the previous email value to preserve accessory IDs.

enableMatterRvc.title: Enable Matter Robot Vacuum
enableMatterRvc.description: Use Matter Robotic Vacuum Cleaner accessory when Matter is available and enabled in Homebridge; otherwise fallback to HomeKit switch.

deviceFilter.title: Device filter
deviceFilter.description: Optional list of exact device names to expose, e.g. Luba-123456.

apiCredentialsPath.title: API credentials file
apiCredentialsPath.description: Absolute path to the private .env file containing MAMMOTION_CLIENT_ID and MAMMOTION_CLIENT_SECRET.
